fields.summary: Autonomous plan run on change set 01M6GCP. The planner traced the failure. run start --new opens the change set in the main checkout, and worktreeWorkspace copies the change set's first .rhiza/log entries into the worktree, so the main checkout keeps them untracked. After the PR merges, ship close-out's git pull --ff-only refuses to overwrite them. ship close-out --forget also deletes the ship state before that pull, so a retry after a failed pull finds no state and fails. With no owner present, the planner raised three questions to the arbiter: which intent this fix serves, how to handle the untracked copies, and how a retry should work. The arbiter ruled: the change set serves m24-on-the-vm; close-out removes the main checkout's untracked .rhiza/log files that incoming main has byte for byte, then pulls; --forget deletes the ship state only after main is updated. Nothing is left open.
fields.title: Close-out fix plan, autonomous run
